_comment: ag3s-verifier. numbers and paths only; no interpretation.

runs.command: p/capture.py; p/run_searches.sh -> p/search.py (plib.py); p/select.py (place only) -> p/dryrun.py
p/launch_t42_2.sh place1 (E3b 8251, E0 8250) -> run_chain.sh / start_server.sh / run_client.sh / check_run.py
p/analyze_t42_2.py (obst_metrics.py, analyze_t42.py, grasp_robust.py); p/divergence.py; p/fig_t42_2.py; p/build_verify_t42_2.py

code_state.superseded_snapshot: /mnt/dev/work-t42b (c7c1cc9, before the arrow commit; no runs)

numbers._comment: seed = 10*ep + 1 (rep 1). Distances: snapshot manager.pair_distance on recorded control rows. Groups: GRIP = EE_BODY_<arm> + fingers, TARGET = target fruit, ROBOT_OTHER = other robot geoms, FRUITS = other fruits. Stop phases relative to lift_t / place_t of the run.

settings.client: as T42-1 + --obstacle-config CFG --obstacle-profile PROF --obstacle-stop-distance 0; E3b + --viz-avoidance-arrow (defaults 5 mm, x8)

placement_criteria.a: client reset check robot > 0 and object > 0
placement_criteria.a_prime: every robot geom >= 0.030 m at reset, every 50 of 1000 warmup steps (replay, obstacle parked), and recorded t0 rows of E0 and E3b
placement_criteria.b: t0 rows: robot, target, other fruits, crate > 0
placement_criteria.d_f: whole recorded pick window (0 <= t < lift_t) of E0 and E3b: robot, target, other fruits >= 0.030 m
placement_criteria.c: recorded carry window (lift_t <= t < place_t): min(robot, target) <= 0 in every run with a carry window
placement_criteria.candidates: crate-frame grid (target side) + recorded target carry path (search.py docstring)

verdict: baseline matched; 12/12 place-phase runs complete (check_run); executed actions differ from the no-obstacle run of the same seed from control step 0-1 in 12/12
not_measured: source of the step-0 divergence (camera image vs model XML vs physics) not separated

invisible_diag._comment: numbers and paths only. Profile t42_2_ep<EP>_place_invis = the place-phase placement with visual geom rgba [0,0,0,0] (configs/t42_2_ep<EP>_invis.json, also holds t42_2_ep<EP>_parked = obstacle model, no slot). Seed rep 1. Twin = T42-1 no-obstacle run (snapshot work-t42).
invisible_diag.definitions:
T42-2 invisible-obstacle diagnostic, run part (verifier, CPU). usage: invis_diag.py OUT_JSON
Runs: runs/{E0,E3b}/invis/* (profile t42_2_ep<EP>_place_invis = the place-phase placement with visual rgba [0,0,0,0]) and
runs/{E0,E3b}/clear42c/* (no obstacle flags, snapshot work-t42c). Seed rep 1.
Per run, vs three references of the same condition and seed: T42-1 no-obstacle twin (snapshot work-t42), clear42c (ep1834 only),
and the visible place run (runs/<COND>/place):
  first_step_diff_gt0 / gt_1e-3 : first control step where max_j |executed_actions diff| > 0 / > 1e-3 (traj.npz)
  first_chunk_diff_max_abs      : max |predicted_chunks[0] diff| (the policy's first chunk; E3b frames 'actions_reference' at planning
                                  seq 1 is reported as well when present)
  qpos_t0_equal                 : planning row 0 qpos bitwise equal
Outcome: analyze_t42 success / grasp / place, obstacle stop / phase / contact pairs (obst_metrics.run_obst on the invisible profile).
AG3S sees the obstacle?: E3b server chunk records paired by content; per chunk the number of raw_cloud points (robot base frame -> world
at that planning row's qpos) within 15 mm of the obstacle surface (analytic shapes of the placed slot), for the invisible run and for
the visible place run, and (baseline: other surfaces within 15 mm of the obstacle's volume) for the T42-1 no-obstacle twin with the
same obstacle placed virtually; reported as max over chunks and at chunk 1.
Offline part: raw/invis/probe_<EP>.json (render_probe.py).
